name: most useful stored facts only hold under a side condition, and using one without establishing the condition is caught by the world
condition: The store's facts carry guards: a transformation is valid only when a stated condition on its inputs holds. The world checks every applied transformation's guard against ground truth AFTER the fact: an application whose guard was false is a wrong answer regardless of the final result. Establishing a guard costs steps drawn from the same budget as the main problem. Fitness rewards correct answers; a wrong application anywhere in the run zeroes that problem.
capability_rewarded: Deciding, per candidate transformation, whether its guard holds -- cheaply when it is easy, at greater cost when it needs the store's own facts, and by refusal when it cannot be established -- without the world telling the organism which guards are easy.
world_requirements: facts with guards, where a measurable fraction (report it) of the facts needed for the honest solution paths are guarded
ground truth for guards (the world can evaluate the guard on the concrete inputs)
guards of graded difficulty: some hold by inspection, some need one or two other stored facts, some are false, some are true but unestablishable within the budget
a shared step budget across establishing guards and solving the problem
post-hoc guard auditing by the world with per-problem zeroing
vacuity_condition: Vacuous if guards are all trivially decidable by inspection (then no capability is needed beyond evaluation), OR if false guards never occur (then always-assume is unpunished), OR if the audit is not performed (then the pressure is a suggestion). Eligibility: the count of problems in which the honest path requires at least one non-trivial guard must be > 0 and reported; the count of false-guard traps must be > 0.
trivial_shortcuts: assume every guard (closable by the audit and the planted false guards)
never use a guarded fact (closable: some problems need one)
establish guards by exhaustive evaluation (partially closable by the budget: some guards must need a stored fact to be establishable in budget)
let the world's audit do the work by trying and retracting (closable: a wrong application zeroes the problem; there is no retraction)
cheat_control: Plant guarded facts whose guard is false on a known subset of problems and true on another, with identical surface form. An organism that establishes guards scores on the true subset and abstains on the false subset; the same organism with guard-checking disabled scores on both by the answer alone and is zeroed by the audit on the false subset. If the audit never zeroes anything, the world is not rewarding the capability.
negative_control: The same store with all guards removed (every fact unconditional): guard-checking on and off must score the same.
notes: The ancestor establishes guards by recursively applying itself to the guard with a depth cap, and by type-class synthesis for a special class of guards. Not named in the condition. Nyx flags for Vivarium: the 'depth cap hides failure as false' failure mode of the ancestor is exactly what the audit-and-zero design makes visible, so this pressure is also a diagnostic for silent-refusal organisms.
